AnalysisExecution.description:
Volatile execution envelope, separate from reproducible chain content.

This whole node is excluded from the canonical content hash. It records
tool versions and stage diagnostics without claiming to be reproducible
evidence.

note.default: Execution envelope; not part of reproducible chain content.
note.title: Note

AnalysisExecution.title: AnalysisExecution

AnalysisLimitation.description:
A typed, reason-coded limitation on a value or conclusion.

Used wherever the chain must state *why* something is not observable,
incomplete, secret-protected, or not assessable instead of guessing.
AnalysisLimitation.title: AnalysisLimitation

AnalysisStatus.description: Overall status of a reproducible analysis execution.
AnalysisStatus.title: AnalysisStatus

AnomalyBand.description: Calibrated ML anomaly bands, separate from policy risk.
AnomalyBand.title: AnomalyBand

AnomalyResult.description: View of a model-dependent anomaly score, separate from policy risk.

interpretation_note.const: Anomalous behavior is not proof of malicious activity.
interpretation_note.title: Interpretation Note

AnomalyResult.title: AnomalyResult

ArtifactManifest.description: Tamper-evident hashes and version metadata for produced artifacts.
ArtifactManifest.title: ArtifactManifest

AutomationStatus.description:
What SecureMailScope may do automatically.

For v1 this is always ``advisory_only``; the tool never alters
infrastructure.
AutomationStatus.title: AutomationStatus

CaptureFormat.description: Capture container format recognised from actual tool inspection.
CaptureFormat.title: CaptureFormat

CaptureProvenance.description: Immutable capture provenance as computed by the intake stage (spec §4.2).
CaptureProvenance.title: CaptureProvenance

ChainObservability.description:
Observability of a chain node, exactly as defined by spec §6.1.

``session_secrets_required`` describes protected TLS evidence (for example
the encrypted TLS 1.3 certificate) that requires authorized session secrets
to interpret. It is a valid result, never a value to be guessed.
ChainObservability.title: ChainObservability

CompleteStatus.description: Completeness/observability of a reconstructed analysis result.
CompleteStatus.title: CompleteStatus

CryptoObservation.description: Observable TLS/X.509 fact without policy judgment (spec §4.6).
CryptoObservation.title: CryptoObservation

Direction.description: Inferred direction of a frame relative to the analysed TCP stream.
Direction.title: Direction

Endpoint.description: One transport endpoint of a reconstructed session.
Endpoint.title: Endpoint

EngineStatus.description:
Believability of a versioned sub-engine output.

``not_run`` is used when no rule pack or model was evaluated. A typed
status is used instead of magic-string "-none" sentinel values.
EngineStatus.title: EngineStatus

EventStatus.description: How an event relates to directly observed evidence.
EventStatus.title: EventStatus

EvidenceRedaction.description:
Redaction applied to a safe excerpt or normalized value.

``none`` means the value contains no sensitive material by construction.
EvidenceRedaction.title: EvidenceRedaction

EvidenceReference.description:
A precise reference back to directly observable capture evidence.

(spec §4.4). An EvidenceReference is constrained to *directly observed*
evidence: it must always be ``observability=observed``. Non-observed states
are represented on the events/observations that reference it, never by
fabricating a non-observed evidence entry. This is what makes the
observability invariants internally consistent (there is no
``evidence.limitations`` field).
EvidenceReference.title: EvidenceReference

EvidenceSourceKind.description: Provenance kind of an evidence extraction (spec §4.4).
EvidenceSourceKind.title: EvidenceSourceKind

Finding.description: A versioned policy output linked to evidence (spec §4.9).
Finding.title: Finding

FindingCategory.description: Stable finding categories used by the v1 rule surface.
FindingCategory.title: FindingCategory

LimitationCode.description:
Stable reason codes for limitations on evidence and conclusions.

The codes preserve the exact vocabulary used by the earlier analyzer
output plus the explicit TLS 1.3 and capture-boundary reasons.
LimitationCode.title: LimitationCode

ObservationKind.description:
Observable TLS/X.509 fact kinds (spec §4.6), plus the explicit
unobservable-certificate kind for passive TLS 1.3 captures.
ObservationKind.title: ObservationKind

PolicyRiskContribution.description:
One rule's declared contribution to capture-wide policy risk.

Scoring rules belong to a later commit. This model stores the declared
inputs: severity, confidence, contribution, factor, and adjusted points.
PolicyRiskContribution.title: PolicyRiskContribution

PolicyRiskSummary.description: Separate deterministic policy-risk summary (independent of ML anomaly).
PolicyRiskSummary.title: PolicyRiskSummary

Protocol.description: Content-classified mail transport protocol (SMTP only in E2/E3A).
Protocol.title: Protocol

ProtocolEvent.description: An ordered protocol or TLS transition (spec §4.5).
ProtocolEvent.title: ProtocolEvent

ProtocolEventType.description: Ordered protocol or TLS transition event types (spec §4.5).
ProtocolEventType.title: ProtocolEventType

ProtocolState.description: Reconstructed protocol state used for transition before/after values.
ProtocolState.title: ProtocolState

Recommendation.description: Remediation guidance for findings, advisory-only for submission (spec §4.11).
Recommendation.title: Recommendation

RuleEvaluation.description: Complete evaluation of one versioned policy rule (spec §4.8).
RuleEvaluation.title: RuleEvaluation

RuleReasonCode.description: Machine-readable reason for a rule evaluation outcome.
RuleReasonCode.title: RuleReasonCode

StageDiagnostic.description: Typed runtime diagnostic for one analysis stage.
StageDiagnostic.title: StageDiagnostic

StageId.description: Short identifiers for analysis stages used in typed diagnostics.
StageId.title: StageId

StageStatus.description: Status of one analysis stage inside the execution envelope.
StageStatus.title: StageStatus

StandardsReference.description: A standard citation used by findings/recommendations.
StandardsReference.title: StandardsReference

Tls13SecretsStatus.description:
Whether authorized TLS 1.3 session secrets were supplied for a capture.

The contract records only *that* authorized secrets were supplied, never the
secret material itself. ``not_supplied`` forces TLS 1.3 certificate details
to ``session_secrets_required``/``not_observable``; ``authorized_supplied``
permits observed certificate details that reference actual evidence.
Tls13SecretsStatus.title: Tls13SecretsStatus
